scope: S0-G. Only rows with source_model == yolo12x_bmd45 and class == motorcycle can be removed. YOLO11x car/truck/bus rows are never touched.
order: 1) decide on the FULL floor-0.08 motorcycle set per image (threshold-independent geometry); 2) drop REMOVED rows; 3) apply conf >= t filter for images/counts. removed(t) = removed rows with conf >= t.
size_cap_source: hybrid/summary_report.json motorcycle_flags.bmd45_cap_w_h (data-derived, S0-E finding); a size cap alone NEVER removes a box

R1_ENCLOSES_CLUSTER.meaning: box fully encloses >=3 distinct motorcycle boxes (pairwise IoU<0.5, IoA>=0.9) and is >=10x larger than their median area: aggregate box, not one vehicle

R2_CAPPED_ENCLOSES_VEHICLE_AND_MOTOS.meaning: box at the BMD45 size cap in both dimensions, encloses a YOLO11x vehicle and >=2 distinct motorcycle boxes, >=10x their median area

flag_only_rules.SIZE_CAP_W: width within tol of the BMD45 max width
flag_only_rules.SIZE_CAP_H: height within tol of the BMD45 max height
flag_only_rules.CONTAINS_YOLO_VEHICLE: a YOLO11x car/truck/bus box lies inside (IoA>=vehicle_inside_ioa)
flag_only_rules.OVERLAP_YOLO_VEHICLE: IoU>=overlap_vehicle_iou or covered (IoA)>=covered_by_vehicle_ioa by a YOLO11x vehicle box
flag_only_rules.ENCLOSES_SOME_NOT_SUPPRESSED: >=2 distinct motorcycle boxes inside but no auto-suppress rule fired
flag_only_rules.NESTED_SAME_SIZE: IoU>=0.5 with a same-size (within 1px) motorcycle box of higher confidence
